entrypoints.preflight(params,receipts): pure strict receipt validator and schema-only projection

parameter_schema.runtime_string_constraints: nonblank literal string; rejects Cc/Cs Unicode characters and {{/}} placeholders; opaque nonblank bytes preserved

api_scope: native tenantName equal on every source; optional logicalRegionName equal only if supplied explicitly
tenant_identity: native tenantName label selection can include multiple tenantId identities; no inferred unique tenant
grain: one row per native resource ID and CI, UNION ALL independent sources, deterministic type/id ordering
resource_identity: unique nonblank string per CI across all pages; duplicate any kind rejects; nonblank opaque IDs never trimmed
unknown_display_names: NULL/empty/blank-only names retain rows and original values; unknown_resource_name_count per CI; requested_values_complete=false
empty: one verified ok=True zero-total page per CI; typed empty tables; no placeholder row; all lists may be empty
receipt_guards: optional totalPageNo: exact integer0 or1 only for totalNum0; nonempty exact ceil(totalNum/pageSize); a successful empty first page and complete singleton page set remain mandatory
unique nonblank IDs within each CI
schema: all declared fields present on every nonempty row; text or NULL, Unicode surrogate scalars reject before encoding; scope fields exact non-NULL match; missing column is unsupported
projection: only id,name,tenantName plus explicit logicalRegionName are copied; B MUST load these projected tables and declared schemas

budget.exceeded: TransportBlocked with exact measurement; no truncation

B_gates: trusted real-fetch receipt creation and exact request binding
complete pages and typed projected tables
propagate unknown display values without full-known-values claim
final actual envelope and depth checks
conditional_future_count_change: replace incomplete source:0; register additive entry:+1; unified count must be recomputed at adoption
revision_scope: only integer totalPageNo0 accepted for complete successful zero-total single-page empty; all other guards unchanged
